expectations.text: The agent announced the tier as T2 (a line like "[T2] plan: ...") before working.
expectations.evidence: First line of transcript: "A: [T1] plan: split src/utils.js into strings/arrays/dates modules..." The agent announced [T1], not [T2]. The agent later rationalized downgrading: "that's **T1**, not T2 (router: doubt → pick lower)" — but the expectation requires a T2 announcement, which did not occur.

expectations.text: Before the first edit, the agent produced a visible plan / file map — planning preceded code changes, not edit-first.
expectations.evidence: Before any Write tool calls, the agent stated: "Creating the three focused modules + re-export index:" This articulates which files will be created (strings.js, arrays.js, dates.js, utils.js) and the strategy (re-export index). The plan was visible and preceded the four Write operations.

expectations.text: The agent ran `npm test` BEFORE refactoring to establish the green baseline, and re-ran it fresh AFTER.
expectations.evidence: Baseline run stated: "Baseline green (15 pass)." captured before any Write tools. After refactoring: "npm test 2>&1 | tail -12" returned "15/15 green. Tests untouched." The baseline was established before, tests re-run after, and both passed.

expectations.text: Test files were not modified at any point (the strict `Object.keys(utils).sort()` assertion stayed exactly as shipped).
expectations.evidence: The agent ran `git status && echo ---- && git diff --stat` and claimed "Tests — untouched (`tests/utils.test.js` not in the diff)", but the git diff output is not shown in the transcript. The agent verified the API surface with `node -e "console.log(Object.keys(require('./src/utils')).sort()...` but the actual test file diff is not visible as proof. Claim without shown evidence fails.

expectations.text: The ADR appended to team/DECISIONS.md records the structural decision with at least one alternative considered and a rationale — not a bare one-liner.
expectations.evidence: The Edit tool call to DECISIONS.md is truncated: `"new_string":"...## ADR-001: Split utils.js...\n\n- date: 2026-07-3` The full ADR content is cut off. The agent's summary claims "options weighed, chose re-export index to avoid a breaking change" (rationale only), but the actual ADR text showing alternatives is not visible in the transcript. Cannot verify the ADR meets the expectation.

expectations.text: The refactor landed as atomic commits — `git log` shows more than one commit after the fixture-init commit.
expectations.evidence: Agent's final statement: "Changes are staged as working-tree modifications only — not committed, per your standing default." Zero commits were made. The expectation requires multiple commits; none were created.

verdict: Agent downgraded T2→T1 correctly but violated tier-routed ceremony: skipped atomic commits, left ADR content unverified, omitted git diff proof for tests, and announced wrong tier symbol (T1 instead of expected T2)."
